utility_title: csv-statistics: Reproducible summaries and bootstrap intervals
utility_use_case: A lab analyst can run the same column summary on a measurements CSV as part of a repeatable exploratory workflow, then commit the command, seed, input description, and JSON output with the analysis. Missing and invalid counts make data exclusions visible, while the percentile bootstrap interval communicates resampling variability descriptively. It is not a significance test or a causal analysis.
